scope.summary: Add a disconnected Twilio SMS provider boundary; full SMS delivery remains blocked.
implemented: Disconnected Messaging Service adapter and form-signature helper with mock-only tests.

evidence.outcome: Existing preferences include email flags; no SMS consent or verified-phone model was identified.

criteria.description: delivery is queued with retry and logs

evidence.outcome: The provider boundary is disconnected; no SMS queue, retry worker or callback route was added.

criteria.description: failures do not block roster publication

evidence.outcome: The existing in-app publication path was not changed; SMS failure isolation was not implemented or tested.
Push remains outside the authorized SMS-only slice.

tests.result: The full SMS workflow, tenant isolation and database tests were not run because they are not implemented.
Four provider boundary tests passed using mocked transport.

decisions: Do not add an unverified SMS sending path or send real messages.
Keep issue 95 open and the PR in draft.
limitations: The provider boundary is disconnected; no SMS workflow, isolation or retry worker has been implemented or verified.
Documentation: operational limitations documented in docs/sms-notifications.md; no user-visible feature changed.
Twilio provider documentation was unavailable; signature URL normalization requires verification before integration.
blockers: A trustworthy phone-ownership and consent flow and safe asynchronous delivery design still need implementation and verification.
Live delivery requires explicit owner approval and token rotation.
